post.summary: Create a read-only viewer session (phone) or a pairing preview session (website -> phone)
post.description: kind "viewer" (default): returns a vs_ token usable only for reading this gallery (scene, assets, events, view tickets). It can never write, use the assistant or manage permissions, even if the account is an editor. Access is re-evaluated on every use. kind "preview" (signed-in users): returns a single-use pairingCode + pairingUrl for a QR code (GET /v1/pairings/qr); the phone exchanges it at POST /v1/pairings/claim for its own vs_ token, so no token is ever shown on screen.

get.summary: Resolve a scanned QR code / deep link to the next step
get.description: Send the Authorization header if the app has a session. next: "open" (create a viewer session and load the scene), "sign_in" (authenticate, then resolve again), "claim_pairing" (POST /v1/pairings/claim), "accept_invitation", "join_as_editor" (website). post.summary: Send a push-to-talk voice clip (multipart, asynchronous)
post.description: multipart/form-data. Text fields first: requestId (required), language, audioEnabled ("true"/"false"), selectedNodeIds (JSON array), durationMs. Then the file part "audio": audio/wav, audio/webm, audio/ogg, audio/mpeg, audio/m4a, audio/aac, audio/flac, audio/aiff (detected from content), at most 4194304 bytes and 30 s. The transcript is returned on the command; unclear audio yields needs_clarification instead of an edit.

put.summary: Turn the donation button on/off and set its message (owner)
put.description: The first time donations are enabled, the server creates the gallery's custodial wallet. Its private key is never returned.

post.summary: Start a donation: returns the recipient, a unique reference key and a Solana Pay link
post.description: Browser wallets: build a SystemProgram.transfer to `recipient` and add `reference` as a read-only, non-signer account key, then POST the signature to /v1/donations/{id}/confirm. Mobile wallets: show the Solana Pay QR (/v1/donations/{id}/qr). Either way the server verifies the transaction on-chain before counting it.

lamports.description: 1 SOL = 1,000,000,000 lamports. Omit to let the donor choose in their wallet.

post.summary: Report the transaction signature; the server verifies it on-chain
post.description: 422 DONATION_UNVERIFIED with details.reason: not_found_yet (retryable: retry every few seconds), transaction_failed, reference_missing, wallet_not_credited, amount_too_low, signature_already_counted. Unreported donations are also found by a background poller.

post.summary: Withdraw donated funds to a wallet address (owner, password required)
post.description: Signs and sends a transfer from the gallery wallet. lamports "all" sends the balance minus the network fee. Retrying with the same requestId returns the original withdrawal (never sends twice). Irreversible once confirmed.
